Name: Mobility Comfort and More

Patent Licensing - Reach out now!

The automotive industry is at a pivotal crossroads. As we navigate changing consumer preferences, environmental concerns, and the ever-evolving concept of mobility, the need for innovation has never been greater. I firmly believe that it's time to reimagine our vehicles and the way they impact our lives.

In a world where traditional vehicle trunks often underutilize precious space, leaving passengers cramped for legroom, the Retractable Trunk emerges as a game-changer. Imagine a car with the ability to offer increased legroom, expanded cargo capacity, improved performance, and reduced production costs. The Retractable Trunk can even make it possible to install a third-row seat in mid-size vehicles. And it doesn't stop there; the wheeled detachable box allows for indoor loading and unloading in seconds.

But it's not just about trunk space; it's about revolutionizing the way we use vehicles. Take the example of a small hatchback that can now accommodate up to six large suitcases. Or consider the appeal of mid-size vehicles with additional seating options. These innovations not only simplify vehicle design but also enhance the daily lives of drivers and passengers.

In a similar vein, the Car Bed System addresses a common traveler's woe. Finding suitable accommodation during peak seasons can be a challenge. But what if your vehicle seats could transform into comfortable flat beds, offering you rest, comfort, and flexibility on the road? Not to mention the productivity boost it can provide during extended work hours. For vehicle owners, this innovation presents an opportunity to generate passive income by renting the system and offering additional services.

By integrating these innovations into the vehicle design process, we can redefine our relationship with cars and mobility. It's time for automakers to take a bold step forward, to embrace change, and to lead the way in redefining the automotive industry. The innovations are here!

Name: QISAB
Description:
QISAB, QSO Interferometer Systems AB, is a Swedish innovative company based in Halmstad, Sweden. The company was formed in 2013 as a spin-off from the research of professors Lars Bååth and Bengt-Göran Rosén at the University of Halmstad. 

The company's first product, CWS, is using measurements of coherent and incoherent scattering of laser light. The system is fast and robust and therefore ideally suitable for automated in-line production processes. The CWS makes it possible to scan the entire object quickly and to obtain information about the surface quality with corresponding positioning to the CAD data. The information consist of both statistical values for gloss and waviness as well as the detection of structures and their direction. The technique detects also surface standard deviation (Sq) from 0.010 – 0.350 μm. The product is fully developed and was installed at the first commercial customer in 2016.
QISAB ́s flexible, totally integrated solutions and products for robust industrial conditions has been patented.

The target concept for future industries is usually referred to as “Industrie 4.0”. The QISAB solutions have been especially developed and tested to be plug-in suitable for the next generation industrial processes. The QISAB product is instrumental in replacing manual process steps and we estimate that the new automatic methods will decrease polishing and measuring times by up to 90% and the related costs by up to 75%.

QISAB's vision is to become a world leading player within in-line inspection of surfaces inside the industrial process, including in-line quality control of goods and tools (to determine time of maintenance).

QISAB will strive to provide quality measurement instruments and services to our customers assuring them advantages such as higher added value and total cost savings. QISAB will achieve this by offering flexible system solutions with new technology content.

Our solutions enable convenient and cost-effective implementation of security to customer ́s existing control systems. Example: A PLC (programmable logic controller) is a device that controls physical processes such as turning on/off water pumps/valves in water industry. The market for security of control systems aka SCADA Systems is rapidly growing with huge monetary potential and Cryptango aims to become the market leader.

Precibeo develops nanopositioning solutions that help scientists and engineers solve demanding motion challenges across semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences, photonics, quantum technology, materials science, medtech and consumer electronics.

Our PRECIBEO GO nanopositioning platform combines high force, nanometer precision and centimeter-range linear travel in a compact, modular system. Customers can easily combine linear and rotation stages, actuators, multi-axis assemblies, controllers and accessories into application-specific solutions with up to six axes—reducing the time and complexity of system design and integration.

PRECIBEO GO is engineered for smooth continuous motion, rapid step-and-settle performance and stable self-locking at rest. It enables customers to position heavy loads with nanometer precision where space, stability and repeatability are critical. High-vacuum configurations are available for specialized research, instrumentation and production environments.

Applications range from leveling silicon wafer chucks and moving large microscopy objectives to aligning optical components and pick and place in smartphone camera sensor production. From research laboratories to advanced instruments and production systems, Precibeo helps customers achieve the precise, reliable motion their work demands.

Based in Uppsala, Sweden, our team combines extensive piezo-motor expertise with a practical, collaborative approach. We work closely with customers to develop motion solutions where force, travel and precision must work together.

Name: Weda Robotics
Description:

At Weda Robotics, we believe there’s a better way.

Born on the shores of Sweden and trusted around the world, we design and manufacture remotely operated robots that clean underwater — without draining, without downtime, and without sending people into hazardous spaces.

From municipal wastewater plants to mines, power stations, aquaculture sites, and industrial processors, our systems remove sludge, sediment, and bio-waste efficiently and safely — even while facilities stay in operation.

Our robots are purpose-built for contractors and facility teams who want to:

-Eliminate confined space entry

-Cut downtime and water loss

-Win more contracts with safer, smarter cleaning methods

-Align with ESG, compliance, and sustainability goals

For decades, cleaning meant compromise: safety or speed, cost or conservation. But today, robotics makes it possible to have all four.

Our partners — industrial cleaning contractors, utilities, municipalities, and plant operators — use Weda solutions to scale their impact, reduce environmental footprint, and modernize their services.

Because when we clean without draining, we don't just protect infrastructure —
We protect people and the planet.

Fabriken i Mölnlycke byggdes 1972, efter att företaget vuxit ur sina mycket mindre anläggningar och behövde en tillverkningsyta med mer funktionella arbetsytor. 2024 flyttas produktionen till Finland och vi tog namnet Logisnext Europe Sweden Center AB.

LNE erbjuder materialhanterings- och logistikkunder ett omfattande utbud av toppmoderna gaffeltruckar, lagerutrustning och AGV-lösningar (automatiserade styrda truckar), tillsammans med ställage, IoT-system (Internet of Things) och skräddarsydda paket med kundfokuserade tjänster. Dessa marknadsförs under varumärkena Mitsubishi Forklift Trucks, Cat Lift Trucks, Rocla och TCM. Business idea 
Our mission is to simplify the design of safety systems for mobile and fixed machines. This we achieve by utilising wireless safety techniques, plug and play, and a safety service to our customers.

Products and systems
Our new product, the Safety Simplifier, makes it much easier to make user friendly safety systems. The Simplifier allows safety possibilities to where they are locally required, for example at door entrances where you make the choice for a safety solution, the push buttons you need and trouble shooting information. Machine stop functions can be connected wirelessly through other Safety Simplifiers or direct to an existing safety system. 

Using the Simplifier it is easy to expand and change safety systems. Furthermore the safety documentation and the safety values are included. 

Experience and co-operations
SSP personnel have extensive experience in the design and implementation of safety system solutions. The Safety Simplifier is the first new product resulting form the co-operation between SSP North AB and SSP GmbH. We continue the successful and innovative co-operation from the time in Jokab Safety in Sweden and Germany. Now we are together building up a new global organisation dedicated to the simplification of safety systems and services.

Description:
A GAMECHANGER SINCE 1976
Kjell Lindskog is one of Sweden’s most experienced inventors. He changed the whole tennis world with the world’s first composite racket in 1976. He also invented the world’s first foldable slalom stick that changed the slalom world. Then he took on the security industry and invented the successful security bag, SQS, which was later acquired by Norwegian Strongpoint.

Today he has built up a team of experienced developers and specialists and together they have developed a completely unique and patented technology for measuring, controlling and heating copper meshes which are molded in different soft and hard panels depending on the application. The underlying technology is partly taken from the safety bags, which then led to SQS becoming Europe’s leading player in its industry. At that time, the purpose was to prevent burglary in safety bags. Today, its all about creating heat.

The basic patent is currently available in the USA, Canada, China and seven countries in Europe. Additional patent applications have also been filed but not yet completed. Now the work has begun to productize and commercialize the various applications for new game changers in various industries.

So let us start with the wind industry. Look out for our new Wind Power ProgramTM.

Our qualified team yearly arranges over 100.000 deliveries to around 91 countries across the world. Thanks to a well stocked warehouse and top modern logistics we normally send deliveries the same day as orders are placed. The already extensive product selection is regularly increased by approximately 1500 items per year and now includes nearly 13.500 products.

Name: CEJN Norden AB
Description:
Snabbkopplingar i världsklass

Du hittar CEJN i världens alla hörn och vi är stolta över att anses som världens ledande specialist på snabbkopplingar.
CEJN producerar och utvecklar snabbkopplingar för hydraulik, tryckluft, högtryckshydraulik, vätskor och andningsluft. 
Företaget grundades i Sverige och har utvecklats vidare här, vilket vi är mycket stolta över. För oss är ”made in Sweden” en symbol för hög industriell standard. Lägg till ”by CEJN” och du får en försäkran om en snabbkoppling av hög och förstklassig prestanda.

Name: Inlead Automation AB
Description:
InLead Automation är en komplett leverantör av automationslösningar. InLead vänder sig främst till verkstadsindustrin men jobbar även inom plast och gjuteri. Som Bas i våra lösningar använder vi standard robotar från Fanuc och ABB men också portalrobotar från Österrikiska FRAi. Vi har tagit fram ett antal standardlösningar för svarv och flerop som en kostnadseffektivt lösning, givetvis kan vi också lösa automation efter era önskemål.

InLead Automation is a complete provider of automation solutions. InLead addressed primarily to metal industri but also working in the plastics and foundry . As base of our solutions , we use standard robots from Fanuc and ABB but also gantry robots from Austrian FRAi . We have developed a number of standard solutions for lathe and milling machines as a cost-effective solution , of course can we also solve automation according to your wishes.

Name: AVT Industriteknik AB
Description:
AVT Industriteknik design and manufacture industrial production equipment with a passion for effective production solutions. We deliver tailored solutions based on years of experience, innovative thinking and a dedication to supplying our customers with solutions that surpass their expectations. Intelligent and effective. We deliver production equipments globally.

AVT Industriteknik deliver a comprehensive spectrum of solutions from turn-key bespoke production lines to robot cells, work stations, fixtures and assembly jigs, leak detection machinery and equipment. We provide expert consulting for production engineering and processes. Building on a close collaboration with you our customer, we find the solution to your challenges.


AVT has a workshop, competens in mechanical & electrical design, robot programming, vision technology, HMI, assembly, test run and after delivery support. Combining these competenses results in complete partner for industrial automation. 

The workshop with 7 NC machines and additional manual machines  specialices in welding, milling and turning and manufacture of components for external customers as well as for internal automation projects.

The major strength is within development of advanced machine including many diffrent functionalities and complex production processes.

AVT is a complete supplier also supplying consultant services mainly to companies producing and developing products. We support in development phase with design, prototype buildning, fixturing and preparation for production. Industrializing and implementing new products in production is one of our core competences.

We are continuously looking for talented employees within our field and are growing continously.

Name: OEM International
Description:
OEM is one of Europe's leading technical trading companies and consists of 37 operating units in 14 countries. 
OEM has a broad and detailed range of industrial components from leading suppliers. 
A well structured local market organisation and effective logistics make OEM a better alternative than the supplier ́s own sales organisations. OEM contributes advanced expertise and service and markets the products according to the specific conditions of each respective market.

Name: Lidalco
Description:
Vi marknadsför, lagerhåller och säljer produkter inom områdena specialkabel, spiralkabel, skyddsslang, förskruvningar & installationsmaterial från Panduit.
Lidalco står för kvalitet, flexibilitet, pålitlighet och snabba leveranser.
Vi köper från tillverkare i Europa och USA, säljer till industri, grossister och OEM-kunder. Med ett stort kontaktnät av duktiga tillverkare och leverantörer kan vi erbjuda ett brett och prisvärt sortiment. Vi specialtillverkar även kabel enligt kundspecifikation eller kabelprov, från 500 m. Vi kan erbjuda olika material såsom: Texiline, PUR, TPE, PETP, PE, SABIX, Silikon, Teflon, PVC med flera. Kabel säljs under vårt varumärke EUROFLEX.
Rätt produkt – till rätt pris – levererad i tid till en nöjd kund

Lidalco bildades 1982 av Claes Lidal.
Huvudkontor och lager finns i Helsingborg. Försäljningskontor finns även i Bålsta & Tranås
Lidalco AB – För avancerad kabelteknik – EUROFLEX Specialkabel

Name: Precimeter
Description:
The Precimeter Group is continuously growing, developing new solutions and serving customers in the molten metal industry. With more than 25 years of experience within the industry and with the highest level of knowledge about molten metal level control - Precimeter is the brand that can be trusted to deliver the solutions you need.

Precimeter specializes in automated level control solutions for molten metal casting processes. All our products are specially designed for the harsh conditions in a casthouse environment. We can also offer our expertise to assist you with system design as well as commissioning.

The Precimeter Group includes offices and production in Sweden (HQ), Germany and USA and a sales office in China. With representation in more than 35 countries as well, the Precimeter Group offers excellent service and support to its customers worldwide. 

Moreover, Precimeter Control AB, our headquarters, has successfully established and implemented a management system in accordance with ISO 14001:2015 standards. This system governs our processes for the development and manufacturing of sensors and actuators used in flow control of molten metals.

Name: Front AGV AB
Description: Kompakta och intelligenta AGV:er för produktionsmiljö. Våra självkörande truckar tar liten plats, jobbar på säkert sätt nära människor och är uppkopplade mot övrig produktionsutrustning.

Name: Kameleon Robotics AS
Description:
Kameleon Robotics Norge er en del av Kameleon Gruppen og spesialister på robotisering og automatisering for norsk industri.

Vi utvikler og implementerer robotløsninger som skaper flyt, kapasitet og forutsigbar drift i produksjonsmiljøer med høye krav til presisjon og effektivitet.

Vi leverer:

• Industriroboter og coboter
• AGV og AMR, selvkjørende robotløsninger
• Standardiserte palleteringsløsninger
• Skreddersydde applikasjoner med robot, transportbaner og visionsystemer
• Integrerte løsninger som kobler mekanikk, styring og programvare

Som en del av Kameleon Gruppen bidrar vi med teknisk spisskompetanse innen robotikk og automasjon i helhetlige produksjonsprosjekter.

Løsningene våre skal fungere i drift. Hver dag.

Name: Mabema AB
Description:
World-leading machine vision from Sweden.

Mabema is a Swedish technology company at the forefront of machine vision and AI for industrial applications. For more than 20 years we have helped manufacturers see more, measure more and make better decisions in their production.

Our systems operate in demanding industrial environments around the world and analyze more than 300 million images every day in applications where precision, reliability and data quality are critical.

By combining deep expertise in camera technology, image processing and AI, we develop solutions that turn visual data into real operational value, improving quality, productivity, profitability and sustainability for our customers.

At Mabema we work closely with our customers to solve real industrial challenges and continuously push the boundaries of what machine vision can achieve.

Name: Sinterleghe S.r.l.
Description:
Sinterleghe is a Lean Enterprise supported by enabling technologies of 4.0 industry that designs, produces and sells dressers, electrodes changers and dressing tools. 

Our products, worldwide patented, are approved and purchased from the most important automotive plants and are used for the automatic change and dressing of electrodes for welding guns. 

Sinterleghe ambition is to supply to all Partners and Customers advanced technological solutions with high quality products and a fast lead time. 

The company management, with the commitment of the owner, believe that the results to which the strategic plan aims are a consequence of the constant development of people's skills, trasparent cooperation and comunication, and problem solving orientation to enthusiastically support all stakeholders in achieving their most high objectives in terms of quality, safety, respect of the environment and economic sustainability.

This defines the foundations of the leadership style appreciated in Sinterleghe for the dissemination of corporate culture.

Name: Renishaw Nordic
Description:
Renishaw är ett av världens ledande företag för konstruktions- och vetenskapsteknologi, med expertis inom precisionsmätning och hälsovård. Företaget tillhandahåller produkter och tjänster som används inom så olika användningsområden som tillverkning av jetmotorer och vindkraftverk, tandvård och hjärnkirurgi. Vi är också världsledande inom området additiv tillverkning (som också kallas 3D-utskrift), där de konstruerar och tillverkar industriella maskiner som ”skriver ut” detaljer från metallpulver.

Renishaw-gruppen har just nu 80 kontor i 36 länder, med fler än 5 000 anställda, av vilka fler än 3 000 personer är anställda i Storbritannien. Det mesta av företagets F&U och tillverkning utförs i Storbritannien, och för året som avslutades i juni 2018 nådde Renishaw en försäljning på 611,5 miljoner £, av vilket 95 % var export. Företagets största marknader är Kina, USA, Tyskland och Japan.

Name: Swagelok Sweden
Description:
Swagelok Sweden has been an authorized Swagelok sales and service center since 1973. We provide solutions for all fluid systems within Swedish industry and have a component range to fit most of your needs. 

Swagelok Sweden also offers fluid system support like no other. Our customer focus, experience, and integrity ensure the services you receive will be of the same high-quality you’ve come to expect from our products and our people. When customers are challenged to do more with less, Swagelok Sweden’s expanded offering of services is there to help. Customers become more effective and efficient because of services such as customer training and education, systems assembly, system analyses, and e-commerce, among others.

Name: Teamster
Description:
"Team spirit and individual responsibility "

The name Teamster literally means a “driver of a team of horses used for haulage”. The metaphor, of course, is that we drive our customers' projects forward using all the commitment and know-how we have built up since the company's inception in 1978.

Since that time we have created a corporate culture characterised by a strong team spirit, scope for personal development, and the freedom to take on individual responsibility. In addition to our vast body of expertise and creativity, our corporate culture has been one of the cornerstones of our success. And that's the way it will continue to be in the future.

Name: Pilz Skandinavien K/S, Sverige
Description:
Pilz Skandinavien K/S är ett dotterbolag till Pilz GmbH & Co., som med mer än 2600 anställda över hela världen är ledande inom säker automationsteknologi.
Pilz Skandinaviens huvudkontor med centrallager och administration ligger i Sönderborg, Danmark.

Pilz Skandinavien Sverige har sitt huvudkontor i Kungsbacka.

Huvudkontoret i Tyskland och de 40 dotterbolagen som finns på alla kontinenter, har försäljning och ger applikationslösningar på plats. Produkterna omfattar övervakningsreläer, säkerhetsreläer, programmerbara styrsystem som också finns med godkännande för säkerhet, säkra bussystem, sensorer som ljusridåer/ljusbommar och mekaniska säkerhetsbrytare, operatörspaneler, textdisplayer och servolösningar.

Utöver komponenter erbjuder Pilz också ett brett urval av konsulttjänster, dessa omfattar bl.a. rådgivning, projektering och utbildning. Pilz kan t.ex. hjälpa till med att utforma kursprogram för ett företags anställda eller utföra maskinsäkerhets-/riskbedömningar, säkerhetkoncept/-design och CE-märkningar.

Name: AGVE
Description:
Welcome to AGVE – Automated Guided Vehicles since 1985

The AGVE Group is a leading provider of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV) or Automatic Guided Vehicles and control devices, having 60 dedicated employees worldwide working on Automated Guided Vehicle automation. With in-house design and manufacturing, we have sold more than 2.500 AGV’s and 3.500 AGV control units throughout the world. From single components for vehicle control to fully integrated material handling systems, we offer a wide range of products featuring standard, as well as custom built, AGVs.

The AGVE Group currently has sites in Gothenburg (Sweden), Rotterdam (the Netherlands), Charlotte  (North Carolina), Aachen (Germany), London (United Kingdom) and Seoul (South Korea).

We look forward to being your best partner for your automated future! 

More information? Please visit our website www.agvegroup.com or our YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFjFMdzOB3KWC6kGasK64qQ

Name: Gomero
Description: With connected sensors, analytics, and artificial intelligence, we make predictive maintenance possible.

Name: MAQ AB
Description:
MAQ AB is a supplier of vibration damped tools, for CNC machining of turning, milling and hole making. 

At MAQ, we’ve pioneered a technology that simplifies machining by eliminating costly vibration, reducing the need for secondary operations while: Improving Surface Finish; Accelerating Cycle Time; Decreasing Tooling Costs; Lowering Scrap Rates; and Reducing Energy Consumption Rates.

Name: Gemü Sverige
Description:
GEMÜ is one of the world's leading manufacturers of valves, measurement and control systems. Since its foundation in the year 1964, this globally focused, independent family owned enterprise has established itself in important industrial sectors thanks to its innovative products and customised solutions for process media control. GEMÜ is the world market leader for sterile valve applications in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. 

Today, the GEMÜ Group employs more than 2,500 worldwide. Production takes place at eight locations: In addition to the two production sites in Germany, GEMÜ manufactures its products in Brazil, China, France, India, Switzerland and the USA. Their worldwide marketing is carried out across 25 subsidiaries, coordinated from Germany. Thanks to a large network of commercial partners, GEMÜ is now active in over 50 countries on all continents. The Swedish HQ is located in Lindome, south of Gothenburg.

Name: Spitze AB
Description:
Med omtanke för miljön utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller vi kundanpassade förpackningsmaskiner av hög kvalitet. 

Våra maskiner är flexibla, hygieniska och ergonomiska att arbeta med.
Med trygga serviceavtal och ett nära partnerskap med våra kunder garanterar vi driftsäkerhet och hållbar funktionalitet.

Name: PiiA - Process industrial IT and Automation
Description: PiiA (Processindustrial IT & Automation) is a national strategic innovation program with the aim to help grow Swedish process industry by supporting the development of advanced IT and automation solutions. We do this by facilitating cooperation between process industry businesses, their suppliers and research partners. Together, we make Swedish industry more competitive, attract future talent, and lay a solid foundation for Sweden’s ongoing industrial success.

Name: OmniProcess AB, Sweden
Description:
We help the Swedish process industry to increase their efficiency. We are 30 employees placed at 7 locations in Sweden. Our long experience in combination with a very wide range of products gives us the opportunity to offer you optimal solutions:
- Level gauge and level switches
- Pressure sensors, pressure switches and pressure transmitters
- Flow meters
- Equipment for gas analysis
- Instruments and systems for liquid analysis
- Laboratory Automation and instruments

Products from leading vendors such as:
- Yokogawa
- Servomex
- K-Patents
- Bronkhorst High-Tech
- SEAL Analytical

We also offer training courses, workshops, commissioning and troubleshooting.

Name: Rollco AB
Description:
Rollco är specialiserade på komponenter till linjära förflyttningar och automationslösningar till industrin.

Vår målsättning är att hjälpa våra kunder på bästa möjliga sätt, oavsett om det handlar om att hitta rätt produkt, ge snabb teknisk rådgivning eller leverera snabbt. Det är det som driver oss att ständigt förbättra våra produkter och vår expertis. Vi har ett unikt kundfokus som utgår från våra engagerade och motiverade medarbetare.

Vi har ett stort utbud av bl.a. skenstyrningar, kulbussningar och axlar, kulskruvar, kompletta rem- och skruvenheter, utdragsskenor samt diverse tillbehör. Styrningarna finns i många storlekar och material med möjlighet till ytbehandling. I vårt sortiment ingår även bandtransportörer och ett brett sortiment aluminiumprofiler som vi bearbetar och monterar. Vi erbjuder 2D och 3D CAD-filer på alla våra standardprodukter och vi hjälper gärna till med konstruktionsförslag.

Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Danmark, Norge, Finland och Taiwan. Vårt huvudkontor med lager och verkstad ligger i Helsingborg.

Name: Front Automation AB
Description:
Front Automation är en komplett leverantör av automation för Plock, Pack och Palletering med robotar som en central del av vårt erbjudande. Front Automation är Preferred Partner till ABB och har mångårig kompetens när det gäller automation. Vi ligger i framkant när det gäller att använda ny teknik och vi är innovativa och idérika. 

Front Automation ingår i automationsgruppen 3Button Group tillsammans med systerbolagen IML tecnologies oc Fröjd Automation.

Name: Gnosjö Automatsvarvning AB
Description:
Med ett 50-tal anställda är vi sedan 1974 specialiserade på svarvning av komplexa detaljer i stora serier med krav på högsta precision. I vår maskinpark ingår rundbordsautomater, Hydromat och CNC-svarvar.

–––––––––

MODERN FÖRETAGSDRIFT MED ERFARENHET

År 1974 är inte bara året då ABBA vinner Eurovision Song Contest. Det är också året då Olle och Solweig Fransson köper Gnosjö Automatsvarvning. Ett företag som svarvat i metall sedan 1947.

Samma dag Olle signerar företagsköpet läggs Solweig in på BB där första dottern Linda föds. Idag har Linda tagit över som vd efter Solweig medan systern Anna Sandberg ansvarar för material- och produktionsstyrning. Men Solweig och Olle är fortfarande i allra högsta grad aktiva i företaget. Fyra decenniers erfarenhet kombinerat med modern företagsdrift är därför en stor del av Gnosjö Automatsvarvnings framgång.

Idag har företaget ett 50-tal anställda. Med unik kompetens inom skärande bearbetning och svarvning av komplexa detaljer i stora serier med krav på högsta precision, har vi kunder inom så skilda områden som fordons- och verkstadsindustri, industrireglage, fästelement och inredningsdesign. Cirka 50 procent av omsättningen kommer från export till främst England, Tyskland, Danmark, Holland, Ungern och USA.

Så här snart fyra decennier sedan företaget köptes 1974 kan vi konstatera att affärsidén efterlevs till punkt och pricka: Vi skall genom vår unika problemlösningskompetens och med modern avancerad utrustning fylla kundens behov av komplexa svarvade detaljer.

Name: SAMSON Sweden
Description:
AND EVERYTHING FLOWS.

Vi i SAMSON Sverige är en ledande leverantör av intelligenta ventillösningar för processindustrin. Med fokus på precision, säkerhet och tillförlitlighet hjälper vi våra kunder att optimera sina processer och nå långsiktig hållbarhet.

Vi har varit verksamma i Sverige i över 45 år och är en del av SAMSON GROUP – ett globalt företag med mer än 100 års erfarenhet inom reglerventilteknik och automation.

Vår nya visuella identitet speglar det som alltid varit vår kärna:
PEOPLE. PASSION. PROGRESS.
Vi tror på starka relationer, tekniskt kunnande och en nyfikenhet som driver utveckling – varje dag.

Med kundfokus, innovation och kvalitet som grund står vi redo att möta framtidens krav.

Name: YML Network
Description:
YML (Young Manufacturing Leaders) helps young people interested in sustainable manufacturing to connect with manufacturing key players, align their skills to the sector needs and be change-makers by participating in events linked with industry, community learning, take part in the World Manufacturing Forum (WMF), becoming an ambassador of the sustainable industry culture. 
YML is an EU funded project by EIT Manufacturing.

Name: EA Mobile Robotics
Description:
EA Mobile Robotics is a leading supplier of customer-specific automation solutions based on Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV) and Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR).

We develop complete solutions that include control, fixturing, and robotic loading and unloading for assembly applications as well as logistics applications for production. Your AGV system can be adapted and supplied with many different navigation options.

Name: HyRobot AB
Description:
HyRobot är ett automationsföretag som hyr ut och säljer kollaborativa robotar (cobots). Vi hjälper er med installation, service och säkerhetsutrustning. Vi är certifierade integratörer för Universal Robots.

Vi automatiserar de mest monotona, repetitiva och ergonomiskt slitsamma arbetsuppgifterna. 
 Palletering
 Paketering
 Maskinbetjäning
 Montering
 Limning
 Plocka & placera

Med snabb leverans och minimal påverkan på ert dagliga arbete så kan vi få ut en robotkollega till er verksamhet. Välj ett av tre upplägg som passar er situation eller ekonomi bäst:
 Korttidshyra
 Långtidshyra
 Köp

Vi bemannar med robotar!

Name: BCM Transtech
Description:
BCM Transtech helps corrugated manufacturers improve production flow through storage, tool handling and accessibility solutions.

As production grows, so does complexity. More tools, more changeovers and more movement create challenges that impact efficiency, control and productivity throughout the plant.

Our solutions are designed to support the processes surrounding production — making tools easier to access, handle, transport and manage. The result is improved workflow, reduced downtime and a more predictable production environment.

With more than 25 years of industry experience, BCM Transtech delivers customized solutions ranging from manual storage systems to fully automated storage and handling installations. Every solution is developed to fit the customer's operational requirements and production setup.

Today, BCM Transtech solutions are installed in more than 800 facilities across 40 countries, helping manufacturers maintain control as production demands continue to grow.

Name: Winteria
Description:
We have developed a system that can measure and control the quality of welded structures. 

Giving our customers the ability to monitor and optimize their welding process.

Name: Flintab AB
Description:
Flintab Group är en ledande nordisk aktör inom vägnings- och inpasseringslösningar. Genom innovativa lösningar och lokal närvaro säkerställer vi operativ stabilitet för våra kunders materialflöden.

I Flintab Group ingår Omnigon, som fokuserar på återvinningscentraler och är sedan 2022 en del av Dacke Industri. Koncernen har huvudkontor i Jönköping, cirka 100 medarbetare och omsätter omkring 200 miljoner SEK.

Name: Fagerberg
Description:
Vi har en fantastisk historia, men vi är inte mycket för nostalgiska tillbakablickar. Vårt fokus är alltid att förse dig med det senaste och bästa inom avancerad kontroll, styrning och mätning av flöden. Det har vi gjort i över 125 år och kanske är det därför vi med rätta kallar oss processindustrins bäste vän.

En del av det beror förstås på att vi har ett oslagbart sortiment, erbjuder avancerade tjänster, utbildningar, snabb service och förstår oss på branscher med mycket specifika och tuffa krav. Men den stora anledningen till vår framgång stavas folket på Fagerberg och den anda som präglar allt vi gör. Vi har förmodligen fler leenden än ventiler på lager – och då har vi ändå rätt många hundra kvadrat lagerhyllor.

Oavsett om det handlar om den minsta ventil eller en komplex helhetslösning finns det ett löfte som vi alltid håller i leveranser: Ett perfekt flöde. För dig.

Name: Business Gnosjöregion AB
Description: Officiell sida för Business Gnosjöregion AB. Ett samägt bolag av Gnosjö, Gislaved, Värnamo och Vaggeryds kommuner.

Name: Init Industry
Description:
We specialise in industrial automation, electrical design, industrial IT, digitalisation and project management. 

Our mission is to add value to our customers through effective solutions for automation, PLC, HMI, SCADA, electrical design, engineering, big data analytics, data visualisation, digital thread, digital twin framework and commissioning.

We provide fast, modern and precise technology, personality and effectiveness based on more than 25 years of world wide commissioning experience. 

Init Industry is a business unit under the Init group and together, our vision is to become a Nordic champion within industrial IT and automation. 

Specialities:
PLC SCADA HMI programming, Commissioning, Electrical design, Project management, Database, Traceability, System integration, Industrial IT, big data analytics, data visualization, digital thread, and digital twin framework.

Name: Camozzi Automation AB
Description: Design and production of components & technologies for Industrial Automation, Transportation and Life Science industries

Name: Jens S. Transmissioner AB
Description:
Jens S. deliver products, solutions and services within transmissions, work with leading manufacturers and brands and we manufacture and adapt components in our own workshop.

We are power transmission. For 75 years we have created, developed and provided products and services within power transmission for the Nordic Industry.

Our products are divided into four different product groups, belt drives, chains and gear drives, gearboxes, couplings and brakes.

Name: ITO PallPack Sverige
Description:
We love to automate processes that make your intralogistics more efficient - and take overall responsibility for our deliveries.
 
Since our inception in 1959, we have looked at technology on the one hand and the customer's business, problem and future prospects on the other. We dare to set the list high and say that our objective is nothing lower than delivering and supporting the very best solution for your company. We are a partner who takes overall responsibility for our solutions.
 
We have our own production of special solutions in the Nordics, as well as collaboration with a number of quality suppliers such as Radpak, Carryline, Savoye, Eurofork, Kuka Robotics, Mosca and more.

Name: SEW-EURODRIVE AB
Description:
We drive the World
Då undrar du säkert vad "Driving the World" innebär?
För oss betyder det att vi hjälper våra kunder att hålla sin verksamhet i rörelse över hela världen.

Vilka är vi?
SEW-EURODRIVE är en världsledande tillverkare av transmissionsteknik och med våra motorer, växlar, automationsteknik och service, ser vi till att hålla våra kunders verksamhet i rörelse - från transportband, tappningsanläggningar till grustag.... Ja till och med ditt bagage på flygplatsen. Kort sagt allt som är i rörelse helt enkelt.

Med över 90 års branscherfarenhet och mer än 20 000 anställda runt om i världen är vi stolta över att kunna erbjuda våra kunder skräddarsydda drivsystem och automationslösningar från vårt omfattande modulprogram, som inkluderar växelmotorer, frekvensomriktare, servomotorer, industriväxlar och decentraliserad transmissionsteknik samt pålitligt service och support.

- Vi står för rörelse, tradition, innovation, kvalitet och service.

Redo att växla upp? Prata med oss om hur du kan säkerställa en säker drift med våra kraftfulla drivsystem och automationslösningar.

Name: RobNor AB
Description:
We are excited to announce TYO Automation, the new brand that brings together our sister companies, RobNor, RobotNorge, and GJ Machine, under one name. Our vision is to make industries across the Nordics more competitive, efficient, and sustainable.

Our offerings include advanced robotic painting systems for spray painting and powder coating of commercial vehicles, automotive components, and a wide range of products across general industries such as plastics, metal, and wood manufacturing.

Our dedicated service department provides lifetime support for your facility, including on-site service, spare parts, upgrades, and training.

What does this mean for you? The best answer lies in our new name: TYO stands for “Transform Your Operations.” We promise to help you achieve a more competitive and efficient production process.

You will find us in Trollhättan, Stavanger, and Ålesund. We are excited to share more about TYO Automation.

#TYO #Automation #RobNor #RobotNorge #GJ

Name: Aratron AB
Description:
We build close relationships and provide Swedish industry with high quality mechanical and electromechanical components and modules for rotation and linear movement. It's something we've been doing since 1971.

Aratron represents 20 or so well-known manufacturers from throughout Europe, the US and Asia.
